Chapter 1242: 5 Da Fu Ancestor (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 1242: Chapter 5 Da Fu Ancestor (Request for Subscription)

“I can’t keep watching.”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun barely maintained his hazy consciousness, quickly stopping the observation of the future timeline, and gradually restored his turbulent state of mind.

However, the temporal backlash from this forced peering into the future would take him at least several years to dispel.

“This?”

After calming down, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun was extremely shocked inside. Time beings, although they can glimpse future timelines, have certain limitations.

For example, the future holds innumerable timelines, even as powerful as Thirteenth Order, they could at most observe a portion of the timelines and could not grasp all futures.

Moreover, when the observed future timeline involves same-level time beings, it becomes exceptionally difficult, and could even result in backlash.

Plus, the further the future observed, the more variables there are, increasing the difficulty of viewing.

“I suffered a significant backlash?”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun was solemn. He tried to glimpse the future of Lin Yuan after long years, but was directly hit by this kind of backlash, with only a few possible scenarios.

One is that in those distant years, Lin Yuan established a causal relationship with an incomparably powerful time being, and with the protection of that powerful time being, he naturally couldn’t see more details.

Another is that Lin Yuan is in some special environment, between dimensions, where some origins of time exist, which can interfere with the future lines that Thirteenth Order beings could observe.

The third possibility is that after those long years in the future, Lin Yuan himself has already become an incomparably powerful time being, able to block all observations, even if these observations come from the past.

Apart from these three scenarios, there are some other possibilities, though they are less likely.

…

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun looked solemn, leaning more toward the third scenario.

Because just from what could be seen in certain timelines, it could be judged that Lin Yuan’s growth speed was astonishingly fast.

Even after stepping into the Thirteenth Order, he continued to grow at a terrifying rate, with at least Da Ling Ancestor and Da Fu Ancestor having no power to contend with Lin Yuan in the future.

Of course, the future seen by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun is only one possibility, and in the actual future, Da Ling Ancestor and Da Fu Ancestor might not necessarily oppose Lin Yuan.

…

“The reason I can currently glimpse these futures of the Galaxy is because his life level is still low, at the Heavenly Venerate Realm.”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun thought quietly. To him, whether Peak Venerable or top Peak Venerable, Strongest Venerable or Invincible Venerable, all were at the Venerate level.

“Once he crosses into the Thirteenth Order, it will be very difficult to peer into his future.”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun mused to himself.

Directly glimpsing the future of same-level time beings is not only difficult but also very blurry, with much incomplete information.

The struggle and arrangements among Thirteenth Order levels are judged through observing numerous possibilities in many timelines, to discern the strategies or arrangements of other time beings, and then make responses.

Whether one can truly discern the strategies and arrangements of other time beings depends on how many different future timelines are visible.

Unable to directly peer into a specific time being’s future, one has to indirectly infer and guess by observing the future across countless timelines they are in.

“It seems like I’ll have to start watching timelines again soon, as the presence of the Galaxy in the future is likely to bring significant variables.”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun thought, for time beings, aside from cultivation, was watching future timelines. However, when time beings watched future timelines, they generally went deep into a particular timeline, which would result in spending a lot of time.

Before seeing Lin Yuan, the timelines the Ancestor of Fierce Sun had been observing spanned hundreds of thousands of years to millions of years, starting from hundreds of thousands to millions of years ago.

During that time, Lin Yuan had not yet descended upon this Origin Source World, so in the many timelines seen by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, Lin Yuan wasn’t present, which is why he hadn’t noticed such a monstrous talent emerging in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Now, after confirming Lin Yuan’s existence, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun naturally decided to abandon the previously observed timelines and start watching again from this moment.

With Lin Yuan’s inevitable Thirteenth Order intervention, it seems the future of this Origin Source World will head in a different direction, and the timelines seen now will be entirely different from what was seen before.

“Unbelievable…” The Ancestor of Fierce Sun sighed inwardly, learning through watching Lin Yuan’s future, realized that amid the boundless variables of the future, there actually exists some form of certainty.

“It’s said that Time Lords who are soon to impact becoming Perfect Time Beings begin to consolidate their timelines, unifying past, present, and future. Yet, the Galaxy hasn’t even reached the Thirteenth Order, how can such a scene of a determined future be achieved?”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun pondered for a moment, then continued to watch future timelines again.

…

Galaxy Royal Mansion.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, concentrating most of his mind on comprehending the operation of the Origin Source World, while the remaining focus was on processing and watching numerous supreme inheritance guidelines, to perfect the branches of the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

The branches of the Martial Arts Evolution Road had long matured, and what Lin Yuan needed to do now was to perfectly integrate these branches into this Fang Yuan World.

Each dimension has its unique rules, like in the Chaos Void, where during life’s key transition points, there is a gift of infused Chaos Void Origin, hence the prevalence of internal universes.
